description:
The Huffy Electro Light 18" Kids Bike brings excitement to every ride with a vibrant LED light-up frame that helps kids stand out wherever they go. Whether cruising around the neighborhood, riding with friends, or enjoying an evening spin, the glowing design adds extra fun and energy to every adventure.
Featuring Huffy’s EZ Build assembly system, this bike is designed to get kids riding faster with a simpler setup process. The easy-to-use single-speed drivetrain keeps riding straightforward and smooth, allowing young riders to focus on building confidence, exploring new places, and enjoying every moment on two wheels.
Training wheels provide added stability while riders develop balance and coordination. A comfortable padded seat helps support longer rides, while the bold, modern styling delivers a cool look kids will love to show off. Built for fun and confidence, the Electro Light is ready for every ride ahead.

components.description: Easy Coaster Brake: Simple pedal-back stopping helps kids stay in control.
